questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg valgte Belfast, fordi jeg var meget interesseret i kulturen, universitetet havde et rigtig godt ry og det var et engelsk talende land.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Opholdet levede op til alle forventninger, både socialt og studiemæssigt.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Alt information fra Queens var meget tilgængeligt og de er desuden virkelig hjælpsomme til at svare på spørgsmål og svarer hurtigt - både inden og under opholdet.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Hjælp til studerende var virkelig godt! De gjorde enormt meget ud af at hjælpe både på universitetet og kollegiet, som universitetet også hjælper en med at få en plads på.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: meget nemt, universitetet hjælper dig og du er garanteret en plads, hvis du overholder ansøgningsfristerne.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Kollegiet er ikke på campus, men det tager 15-20 minutter at gå til studiet.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer:
Kollegiet var billigt og egentlig fint nok - men sengen er meget hård, vil helt klart anbefale at købe en topmadras med det samme! Man deler bad og toilet med fem andre, men det fungerer faktisk helt fint. 
Der er rent, men det er et meget lille værelse og ret koldt i vintermånederne, men fint til prisen.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
What kind of help was available? *
How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle de fag, jeg søgte. Skiftede også et fag da jeg kom derhen, det kan man frit  gøre inden for de første to uger.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det var nogle spændende fag og fedt at have undervisning, hvor læreren ved hvem man er og giver feedback og vejledning undervejs - noget helt andet end undervisning på KU! Det er en rigtig god mulighed for faktisk at lærer noget og forbedre sig.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: De var alle postgraduate - synes niveauet var rimelig tilsvarende KU. Det fag jeg havde om Nordirlands politik var meget svært, men det skyldtes nok mest ikke at være fra landet.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Man får undervisning i mindre klasser 10-20 elever. Undervisning er meget mere intergerende og man har gruppediskussioner i alle timer.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
- The Politics and Institutions of Northern Ireland 
- The Politics and Political Economy of Energy and Low Carbon Energy Transitions
- Climate,Justice & Human Rights

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
- The Politics and Political Economy of Energy and Low Carbon Energy Transitions - spændende fag hvis man er interesseret i energi og klimapolitik. Læreren er meget energisk, lidt specielt og meget politisk, men også meget hjælpsom til at vejlede. 

- The Politics and Institutions of Northern Ireland  - virkelig interesant fag hvis man vil lærer om det nordirske system.

Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg havde set frem til deres sportsklub tilbud men de fleste deltagende var meget unge 17-18 år og i flere klubber skulle man starte i efteråret for at være med. Man får fitness med i kollegie prisen og det er super fint.

questions.answer: Der er mange tilbud med udflugter osv.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Udforsk naturen i Nordirland, især nordkysten - det er enormt smukt!

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer:
- se musenden temple ved castle rock, giants causeway, robe bridge, port rush, port steward. 
- i Belfast: udforsk pubs og se the peace lines
